marketing:v11.faq.q1.a.en:
These are the documents needed for admission. Some universities and departments ask for more, and you can also submit recommendation letters from teachers or employers, or a certificate of olympiad participation.

1. * High school or junior college graduation certificate, translated into English, notarized and apostilled
2. Academic transcript, translated into English, notarized and apostilled
3. Copy of your passport
4. Copies of both parents' passports. If a parent has no passport, a copy of their ID card, translated into English and notarized
5. Birth certificate or family relationship certificate, translated and notarized
6. Proof of Korean or English ability (TOPIK, TOEFL, IELTS or equivalent evidence)
7. Bank balance certificate showing USD 15,000 or more, valid for 30 days (the amount can vary with the university's location)
marketing:v11.faq.q1.a.cur:
Ito ang mga dokumentong kailangan para sa admission. May mga unibersidad at department na humihingi ng iba pa, at puwede ka ring magsumite ng recommendation letter mula sa guro o employer, o sertipiko ng paglahok sa olympiad.

1. * Sertipiko ng pagtatapos sa high school o junior college, isinalin sa English, notarized at may apostille
2. Transcript of records, isinalin sa English, notarized at may apostille
3. Kopya ng pasaporte mo
4. Kopya ng pasaporte ng parehong magulang. Kung walang pasaporte ang magulang, kopya ng kanyang ID card, isinalin sa English at notarized
5. Birth certificate o sertipiko ng ugnayang pampamilya, isinalin at notarized
6. Patunay ng kakayahan sa Korean o English (TOPIK, TOEFL, IELTS o katumbas na patunay)
7. Sertipiko ng balanse sa bangko na nagpapakita ng USD 15,000 o higit pa, valid nang 30 araw (puwedeng mag-iba ang halaga depende sa lokasyon ng unibersidad)

marketing:v11.faq.q1.q.en: Which documents do I need to apply?
marketing:v11.faq.q1.q.cur: Anong mga dokumento ang kailangan ko para mag-apply?

marketing:v11.faq.q10.a.en: It depends on your field. Graduates in engineering and business usually find work more easily than graduates in the humanities.
marketing:v11.faq.q10.a.cur: Depende sa kurso mo. Kadalasang mas madaling makahanap ng trabaho ang mga nagtapos ng engineering at business kaysa sa mga nagtapos ng humanities.

marketing:v11.faq.q10.q.en: Is it easy to find a job in Korea after graduating?
marketing:v11.faq.q10.q.cur: Madali bang makahanap ng trabaho sa Korea pagka-graduate?

marketing:v11.faq.q2.a.en: Most Korean universities ask for a Korean or English test result (TOPIK, TOEFL or IELTS). Some also accept their own Korean-language test instead.
marketing:v11.faq.q2.a.cur: Karamihan sa mga unibersidad sa Korea ay humihingi ng resulta ng Korean o English test (TOPIK, TOEFL o IELTS). May ilan ding tumatanggap ng sarili nilang Korean test bilang kapalit.

marketing:v11.faq.q2.q.en: Do I need a TOPIK score?
marketing:v11.faq.q2.q.cur: Kailangan ko ba ng TOPIK score?

marketing:v11.faq.q3.a.en: Universities accept TOPIK, TOEFL and IELTS. Some also accept a certificate from a university's Korean language institute in Korea, a pass in the university's own Korean test, or a King Sejong Institute certificate at intermediate level 1 or above.
marketing:v11.faq.q3.a.cur: Tinatanggap ng mga unibersidad ang TOPIK, TOEFL at IELTS. May ilan ding tumatanggap ng sertipiko mula sa Korean language institute ng isang unibersidad sa Korea, pagpasa sa sariling Korean test ng unibersidad, o sertipiko ng King Sejong Institute na intermediate level 1 pataas.

marketing:v11.faq.q3.q.cur: Anong mga language test ang tinatanggap?

marketing:v11.faq.q4.a.en: Yes. On an English-taught program you can study entirely in English.
marketing:v11.faq.q4.a.cur: Oo. Sa programang itinuturo sa English, puwede kang mag-aral nang buong-buo sa English.

marketing:v11.faq.q4.q.en: Can I apply if I don't speak Korean?
marketing:v11.faq.q4.q.cur: Puwede ba akong mag-apply kahit hindi ako marunong mag-Korean?

marketing:v11.faq.q5.a.en: They depend on the university and the program. We recommend starting at least six months before your course begins so there is time to prepare your documents. Language courses usually need less lead time.
marketing:v11.faq.q5.a.cur: Depende ito sa unibersidad at sa programa. Inirerekomenda naming magsimula nang hindi bababa sa anim na buwan bago magsimula ang kurso mo para may oras kang ihanda ang mga dokumento. Kadalasang mas maikli ang kailangang paghahanda para sa mga language course.

marketing:v11.faq.q6.a.en: Most do, but the amounts and the conditions differ from one university to another.
marketing:v11.faq.q6.a.cur: Karamihan ay mayroon, pero magkakaiba ang halaga at mga kondisyon sa bawat unibersidad.

marketing:v11.faq.q6.q.en: Which universities offer scholarships to international students?
marketing:v11.faq.q6.q.cur: Aling mga unibersidad ang may scholarship para sa international students?

marketing:v11.faq.q7.a.en: There is no minimum grade to apply to a Korean university, but higher grades give you a better chance at the universities you want.
marketing:v11.faq.q7.a.cur: Walang minimum na grado para makapag-apply sa unibersidad sa Korea, pero kapag mas mataas ang grades mo, mas malaki ang tsansa mo sa mga unibersidad na gusto mo.

marketing:v11.faq.q8.a.en: Most Korean universities have no age limit, though a few do. If that applies to you, we can suggest universities where age is not an issue. Either way you need a high-school or junior-college graduation certificate.
marketing:v11.faq.q8.a.cur: Karamihan sa mga unibersidad sa Korea ay walang age limit, pero may ilan na mayroon. Kung apektado ka nito, puwede kaming magmungkahi ng mga unibersidad kung saan hindi isyu ang edad. Alinman dito, kailangan mo ng sertipiko ng pagtatapos sa high school o junior college.

marketing:v11.faq.q9.a.en: Yes. You can apply to a Korean university as soon as you graduate from high school or junior college.
marketing:v11.faq.q9.a.cur: Oo. Puwede kang mag-apply sa unibersidad sa Korea pagka-graduate mo sa high school o junior college.

marketing:v11.faq.q9.q.cur: Puwede ba akong pumasok agad sa unibersidad pagkatapos ng high school?

marketing:v12.privacy.collect.noCard.en: When you pay, the card number and expiry date you enter pass through Hangyul's server to the payment provider (Toss Payments) for approval; Hangyul does not store them. Hangyul does not ask for the card PIN, the security code or your date of birth. Hangyul keeps only the order, the amount, the payment status and the provider's transaction reference. If you choose to save the card, Hangyul also keeps the issuer and the masked card number (last four digits) that the provider returns.
marketing:v12.privacy.collect.noCard.cur: Kapag nagbayad ka, dumadaan sa server ng Hangyul ang inilagay mong numero ng card at petsa ng expiry papunta sa payment provider (Toss Payments) para sa pag-apruba; hindi ito iniimbak ng Hangyul. Hindi hinihingi ng Hangyul ang PIN ng card, ang security code o ang petsa ng kapanganakan mo. Ang iniingatan lang ng Hangyul ay ang order, halaga, status ng bayad at transaction reference ng provider. Kung pipiliin mong i-save ang card, iniingatan din ng Hangyul ang issuer at ang naka-mask na numero ng card (huling apat na digit) na ibinabalik ng provider.

marketing:v12.privacy.collect.passport.en: Your passport number is stored masked, with only the last three characters in the clear. The passport document itself is held in your document vault, and every access to it is recorded.
marketing:v12.privacy.collect.passport.cur: Naka-mask ang iyong numero ng pasaporte, at ang huling tatlong character lang ang nakikita. Nasa iyong taguan ng dokumento ang mismong pasaporte, at itinatala ang bawat pag-access dito.

marketing:v12.privacy.processors.intro.en: Hangyul entrusts the work below to external processors, who process personal information only on Hangyul’s instructions. marketing:v12.privacy.processors.none.en: No processor currently handles personal information on Hangyul’s behalf in production. If that changes, the processor and the work entrusted to it will be published here and announced before it begins.

marketing:v12.privacy.processors.retenti.en: The processor publishes no separate retention period. Hangyul receives only the verification result (a token) and does not keep it.

marketing:v12.privacy.processors.sendgri.cur: Pagpapadala ng email verification at mga email ng account (pag-reset ng password, imbitasyon)

marketing:v12.privacy.processors.tosspay.en: Approving, canceling and refunding payments for paid services
marketing:v12.privacy.processors.tosspay.cur: Pag-apruba, pagkansela at pag-refund ng bayad para sa mga bayad na serbisyo

marketing:v12.privacy.processors.twilio_.en: Sending the mobile verification text message (one-time code)
marketing:v12.privacy.processors.twilio_.cur: Pagpapadala ng text message para sa mobile verification (one-time code)

marketing:v12.privacy.retention.complain.cur: Mga tala ng reklamo ng consumer at paglutas ng hindi pagkakaunawaan

marketing:v12.privacy.retention.contract.cur: Mga tala ng kontrata at pagkansela ng order

marketing:v12.privacy.retention.payment..cur: Mga tala ng bayad at ng pagbibigay ng serbisyo

marketing:v12.privacy.retention.rule.en: When the purpose we processed your information for has been achieved, we destroy it without delay.
marketing:v12.privacy.retention.rule.cur: Kapag natupad na ang layunin ng pagproseso namin ng iyong impormasyon, sinisira namin ito agad.

marketing:v12.privacy.retention.statutor.en: Information the law requires us to retain is kept separately, for the period that law specifies.
marketing:v12.privacy.retention.statutor.cur: Ang impormasyong kailangang iingatan ayon sa batas ay hiwalay na iniingatan, sa panahong itinakda ng batas na iyon.

marketing:v12.privacy.rights.access.en: Access: see what information we hold about you
marketing:v12.privacy.rights.access.cur: Pag-access: tingnan kung anong impormasyon tungkol sa iyo ang hawak namin

marketing:v12.privacy.rights.correct.en: Correction: fix information that is wrong

marketing:v12.privacy.rights.delete.en: Deletion: remove information, other than records the law requires us to keep
marketing:v12.privacy.rights.delete.cur: Pagbura: alisin ang impormasyon, maliban sa mga talang kailangan naming iingatan ayon sa batas

marketing:v12.privacy.rights.how.en: You can raise an access, export or deletion request yourself in <settings>account settings</settings>. Requests are recorded with a due date, and you can follow their progress on the same screen.
marketing:v12.privacy.rights.how.cur: Maaari kang magsumite mismo ng kahilingan sa pag-access, pag-export o pagbura sa <settings>settings ng account</settings>. Itinatala ang mga kahilingan na may takdang petsa, at masusubaybayan mo ang progreso nito sa parehong screen.

marketing:v12.privacy.rights.intro.en: You can ask us at any time to:
marketing:v12.privacy.rights.intro.cur: Maaari mo kaming hilingin anumang oras na:

marketing:v12.privacy.rights.suspend.en: Suspension: stop processing for a time

marketing:v12.privacy.rights.withdraw.en: Withdraw consent: for anything processed on the basis of your consent
marketing:v12.privacy.rights.withdraw.cur: Pagbawi ng pahintulot: para sa anumang pinoproseso batay sa pahintulot mo

marketing:v12.privacy.scope.en: This policy applies to the Hangyul Univ website and mobile apps and to the study-abroad preparation and application services Hangyul provides. Hangyul complies with the Personal Information Protection Act and related law.
marketing:v12.privacy.scope.cur: Saklaw ng patakarang ito ang website at mga mobile app ng Hangyul Univ at ang mga serbisyo ng Hangyul sa paghahanda at pag-apply para sa pag-aaral sa ibang bansa. Sumusunod ang Hangyul sa Personal Information Protection Act at mga kaugnay na batas.

marketing:v12.privacy.security.access.en: Access control: only you, the agency assigned to you and a university you have submitted an application to can reach your information, and permission is re-checked on the server with every request.
marketing:v12.privacy.security.access.cur: Kontrol sa pag-access: ikaw lang, ang ahensyang nakatalaga sa iyo at ang unibersidad na pinagsumitehan mo ng aplikasyon ang makaaabot sa impormasyon mo, at sinusuri muli ang pahintulot sa server sa bawat kahilingan.

marketing:v12.privacy.security.audit.en: Access logging: document views, reviews and exports are recorded, together with whose information was seen.
marketing:v12.privacy.security.audit.cur: Pagtatala ng pag-access: itinatala ang pagtingin, pagsusuri at pag-export ng dokumento, kasama kung kaninong impormasyon ang nakita.

marketing:v12.privacy.security.links.en: Document files have no public address. They can be downloaded only through a short-lived link issued after a permission check.
marketing:v12.privacy.security.links.cur: Walang pampublikong address ang mga file ng dokumento. Mada-download lang ang mga ito sa pamamagitan ng panandaliang link na ibinibigay pagkatapos suriin ang pahintulot.

marketing:v12.privacy.security.passwords.en: Passwords are stored in a form that cannot be reversed, and sign-ins are recorded.
marketing:v12.privacy.security.passwords.cur: Iniimbak ang mga password sa anyong hindi na maibabalik, at itinatala ang mga pag-sign in.

marketing:v12.privacy.security.roles.en: Separation of roles: an agency counselor sees only the students assigned to them; a university analyst has read-only access.
marketing:v12.privacy.security.roles.cur: Paghihiwalay ng tungkulin: ang mga estudyanteng nakatalaga lang sa kanya ang nakikita ng counselor ng ahensya; read-only ang access ng analyst ng unibersidad.

marketing:v12.privacy.security.transport.en: Encryption in transit: all traffic travels over an encrypted connection.
marketing:v12.privacy.security.transport.cur: Encryption habang ipinapadala: dumadaan ang lahat ng trapiko sa naka-encrypt na koneksyon.

marketing:v12.privacy.security.uploads.en: Uploads are checked for file type and size and scanned for malware before they can be reviewed.
marketing:v12.privacy.security.uploads.cur: Sinusuri ang uri at laki ng mga in-upload na file at ini-scan para sa malware bago masuri.

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.agency.ite.en: Account details, study-abroad profile, and the documents and consultation records attached to the applications it handles
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.agency.ite.cur: Mga detalye ng account, profile sa pag-aaral sa ibang bansa, at ang mga dokumento at tala ng konsultasyon na nakakabit sa mga aplikasyong hinahawakan nito

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.agency.pur.cur: Konsultasyon, pagsusuri ng dokumento, paghahanda ng aplikasyon

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.agency.whe.en: When you buy a plan that includes agency support, or agree to be assigned to an agency
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.agency.whe.cur: Kapag bumili ka ng plan na may kasamang suporta ng ahensya, o pumayag kang italaga sa isang ahensya

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.notAll.en: Not every university or agency receives every document. What is actually provided depends on the service you chose and the state of your application, and you can see where each document has been sent in your document vault.
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.notAll.cur: Hindi lahat ng unibersidad o ahensya ay tumatanggap ng bawat dokumento. Nakadepende ang aktuwal na ibinibigay sa serbisyong pinili mo at sa estado ng iyong aplikasyon, at makikita mo sa iyong taguan ng dokumento kung saan naipadala ang bawat dokumento.

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.rule.en: Hangyul processes your personal information within the purposes it was collected for, and does not disclose it to third parties except with your consent or on a legal basis.
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.rule.cur: Pinoproseso ng Hangyul ang iyong personal na impormasyon sa loob ng mga layunin kung bakit ito kinolekta, at hindi ito ibinabahagi sa third party maliban kung may pahintulot mo o legal na batayan.

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.sponsor.it.en: Only the scopes you select (never document files, messages or consultation notes)
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.sponsor.it.cur: Ang mga saklaw lang na pipiliin mo (hindi kailanman ang mga file ng dokumento, mensahe o tala ng konsultasyon)

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.sponsor.pu.en: Sharing the progress you choose to share
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.sponsor.pu.cur: Pagbabahagi ng progresong pinili mong ibahagi

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.sponsor.wh.en: When you create a read-only link, which you can revoke at any time
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.sponsor.wh.cur: Kapag gumawa ka ng read-only na link, na maaari mong bawiin anumang oras

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.university.en: Your application, the profile fields the application needs, and the documents shared with that application
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.university.cur: Ang iyong aplikasyon, ang mga field ng profile na kailangan ng aplikasyon, at ang mga dokumentong ibinahagi sa aplikasyong iyon

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.university.en: When you submit an application to that university
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.university.cur: Kapag nagsumite ka ng aplikasyon sa unibersidad na iyon

marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.whenApplyi.en: If you use the application or study-abroad support services, the information those services need may be provided to the university you are applying to or to the agency assigned to you, according to the service you chose and the stage your case has reached.
marketing:v12.privacy.sharing.whenApplyi.cur: Kung gagamitin mo ang mga serbisyo sa aplikasyon o suporta sa pag-aaral sa ibang bansa, maaaring ibigay ang impormasyong kailangan ng mga serbisyong iyon sa unibersidad na inaaplayan mo o sa ahensyang nakatalaga sa iyo, ayon sa serbisyong pinili mo at sa yugtong naabot ng iyong kaso.

marketing:v12.privacy.summary.en: Hangyul operates Hangyul Univ. We process only the personal information that preparing and submitting a study-abroad application actually needs, and we protect it.
marketing:v12.privacy.summary.cur: Ang Hangyul ang nagpapatakbo ng Hangyul Univ. Pinoproseso lang namin ang personal na impormasyong talagang kailangan sa paghahanda at pagsumite ng aplikasyon sa pag-aaral sa ibang bansa, at pinoprotektahan namin ito.

marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.intro.en: To create and protect your account, the personal information below is transferred to processors outside Korea. The legal basis is Article 28-8(1)3 of the Personal Information Protection Act (entrusted processing needed to conclude and perform the contract with you), and the matters required by Article 28-8(2) are disclosed here.
marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.intro.cur: Para magawa at maprotektahan ang iyong account, inililipat ang personal na impormasyon sa ibaba sa mga processor sa labas ng Korea. Ang legal na batayan ay Article 28-8(1)3 ng Personal Information Protection Act (ipinagkatiwalang pagproseso na kailangan para mabuo at maisagawa ang kontrata sa iyo), at inilalahad dito ang mga bagay na hinihingi ng Article 28-8(2).

marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.none.en: No processor that transfers personal information outside Korea is currently in use. If an overseas transfer becomes necessary, the recipient, country, purpose, information, timing, method and retention period will be published here and announced before it begins.

marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.refuse.en: If you do not want this transfer, do not proceed with sign-up, or tell us at support@talkhangyul.com. Email and mobile verification are required to create an account, so refusing the transfer means an account cannot be created.
marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.refuse.cur: Kung ayaw mo ng paglilipat na ito, huwag ituloy ang pag-sign up, o sabihan kami sa support@talkhangyul.com. Kailangan ang email at mobile verification para makagawa ng account, kaya kapag tinanggihan mo ang paglilipat, hindi makagagawa ng account.

marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.safeguard.en: Safeguards and complaint procedures with each processor are set in their data-processing agreements (Twilio Data Protection Addendum, Cloudflare Customer DPA).
marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.safeguard.cur: Nakatakda sa mga data-processing agreement ng bawat processor ang mga pananggalang at pamamaraan sa reklamo (Twilio Data Protection Addendum, Cloudflare Customer DPA).

marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.universit.en: If you apply to a university in Korea, the information that application needs is provided to that university. That is a disclosure for the application process you chose, on the terms set out in the section above.
marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.universit.cur: Kung mag-a-apply ka sa unibersidad sa Korea, ibinibigay sa unibersidad na iyon ang impormasyong kailangan ng aplikasyon. Pagbabahagi iyon para sa prosesong pinili mo, ayon sa mga kondisyong nakasaad sa seksyon sa itaas.

marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.verified.en: Processor locations and retention periods were checked on 23 October 2026 against each processor’s published documents and will be updated here if they change.
marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.verified.cur: Sinuri noong 23 Oktubre 2026 ang lokasyon at panahon ng pag-iingat ng mga processor batay sa inilathalang dokumento ng bawat isa, at ia-update dito kapag nagbago.

marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.when.en: Each time a verification code is requested at sign-up or when changing contact details; encrypted (TLS) transfer over the internet
marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.when.cur: Sa bawat paghiling ng verification code sa pag-sign up o sa pagpapalit ng contact details; naka-encrypt (TLS) na paglilipat sa internet

marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.whenTurns.en: Each time the sign-up screen is opened and verified; your browser communicates directly with Cloudflare’s servers
marketing:v12.privacy.transfer.whenTurns.cur: Sa bawat pagbukas at pag-verify ng screen ng pag-sign up; direktang nakikipag-ugnayan ang iyong browser sa mga server ng Cloudflare

marketing:v12.seo.directory.description.en: Every university, junior college and graduate institution on the national public-disclosure register, by region.
marketing:v12.seo.directory.description.cur: Bawat unibersidad, junior college at graduate institution sa pambansang public-disclosure register, ayon sa rehiyon.

marketing:v12.seo.directory.title.cur: Mga unibersidad sa Korea ayon sa rehiyon

marketing:v12.seo.privacy.description.en: What personal information Hangyul Univ processes, why, and the rights you have over it.
marketing:v12.seo.privacy.description.cur: Anong personal na impormasyon ang pinoproseso ng Hangyul Univ, bakit, at ang iyong mga karapatan dito.

marketing:v12.seo.terms.description.en: The conditions for using Hangyul Univ, and the rights and duties of Hangyul and of members.
marketing:v12.seo.terms.description.cur: Ang mga kondisyon sa paggamit ng Hangyul Univ, at ang mga karapatan at tungkulin ng Hangyul at ng mga miyembro.

marketing:v12.seo.university.description.cur: Opisyal na impormasyon tungkol sa {{name}} sa {{region}}.

marketing:v12.terms.accounts.p.en: Members must give accurate information when registering and when using the service. An account may be used only by the person it belongs to, and may not be transferred or lent to anyone else without Hangyul’s agreement. If there are signs that an account has been compromised, Hangyul will suspend it to protect the member and tell them.
marketing:v12.terms.accounts.p.cur: Dapat magbigay ng tamang impormasyon ang mga miyembro sa pagrehistro at sa paggamit ng serbisyo. Ang may-ari lang ng account ang maaaring gumamit nito, at hindi ito maaaring ilipat o ipahiram sa iba nang walang pagsang-ayon ng Hangyul. Kapag may senyales na nakompromiso ang account, sususpindihin ito ng Hangyul para protektahan ang miyembro at sasabihan siya.

marketing:v12.terms.changes.h.en: Changes to and suspension of the service
marketing:v12.terms.changes.h.cur: Mga pagbabago at pagsuspinde ng serbisyo

marketing:v12.terms.changes.p.en: Hangyul may change or discontinue parts of the service in order to improve it. Where a change or discontinuation affects the scope of a service a member has already bought, Hangyul will tell the member beforehand and refund the part of what they paid that has not been provided. Where the service is interrupted by maintenance or a fault, Hangyul will give notice as far as it reasonably can.
marketing:v12.terms.changes.p.cur: Maaaring baguhin o itigil ng Hangyul ang ilang bahagi ng serbisyo para mapabuti ito. Kapag naapektuhan ng pagbabago o pagtigil ang saklaw ng serbisyong nabili na ng miyembro, sasabihan siya ng Hangyul nang maaga at ire-refund ang bahagi ng ibinayad na hindi pa naibibigay. Kapag naantala ang serbisyo dahil sa maintenance o aberya, mag-aabiso ang Hangyul hangga't makatwirang posible.

marketing:v12.terms.definitions.agency.d.en: A study-abroad agency under contract with Hangyul that carries out consultations and document work for a member.
marketing:v12.terms.definitions.agency.d.cur: Isang study-abroad agency na may kontrata sa Hangyul at nagsasagawa ng konsultasyon at gawain sa dokumento para sa miyembro.

marketing:v12.terms.definitions.content..en: University information, guidance and forms that Hangyul has produced or collected and that the service provides.
marketing:v12.terms.definitions.content..cur: Impormasyon ng unibersidad, gabay at mga form na ginawa o kinolekta ng Hangyul at ibinibigay ng serbisyo.

marketing:v12.terms.definitions.member.d.en: A person who has agreed to these terms, created an account and uses the service.
marketing:v12.terms.definitions.member.d.cur: Taong sumang-ayon sa mga tuntuning ito, gumawa ng account at gumagamit ng serbisyo.

marketing:v12.terms.definitions.service..en: The Hangyul Univ website and mobile apps, and the study-abroad preparation and application features provided through them.
marketing:v12.terms.definitions.service..cur: Ang website at mga mobile app ng Hangyul Univ, at ang mga feature sa paghahanda at pag-apply para sa pag-aaral sa ibang bansa na ibinibigay sa mga ito.

marketing:v12.terms.definitions.support..en: The paid services a member chooses, such as consultations, document review, editing of personal statements and study plans, and application management.
marketing:v12.terms.definitions.support..cur: Ang mga bayad na serbisyong pinipili ng miyembro, gaya ng konsultasyon, pagsusuri ng dokumento, pag-edit ng personal statement at study plan, at pag-manage ng aplikasyon.
Serbisyo ng suporta sa pag-aaral sa ibang bansa

marketing:v12.terms.definitions.universi.en: The Korean higher-education institution a member applies to.
marketing:v12.terms.definitions.universi.cur: Ang institusyon ng mas mataas na edukasyon sa Korea na inaaplayan ng miyembro.

marketing:v12.terms.duties.p.en: Members must submit information and documents that are true. Members must not impersonate another person, submit forged or altered documents, misuse accounts, interfere with the proper operation of the service, or infringe the rights of others.
marketing:v12.terms.duties.p.cur: Dapat magsumite ang mga miyembro ng totoong impormasyon at dokumento. Hindi dapat magpanggap ang miyembro bilang ibang tao, magsumite ng peke o binagong dokumento, gamitin nang mali ang account, guluhin ang maayos na pagpapatakbo ng serbisyo, o lumabag sa karapatan ng iba.

marketing:v12.terms.fees.provider.en: Card details are entered on Hangyul's payment screen and passed through Hangyul's server to the payment provider (Toss Payments) for approval. Once payment completes, the transaction appears in your account.
marketing:v12.terms.fees.provider.cur: Inilalagay ang detalye ng card sa payment screen ng Hangyul at ipinapasa sa server ng Hangyul papunta sa payment provider (Toss Payments) para sa pag-apruba. Kapag nakumpleto ang bayad, lalabas ang transaksyon sa iyong account.

marketing:v12.terms.fees.shown.en: The price of a paid service and what it includes are shown on that product’s page before payment, and nothing is charged beyond the amount shown.
marketing:v12.terms.fees.shown.cur: Ipinapakita sa pahina ng produkto bago magbayad ang presyo ng bayad na serbisyo at kung ano ang kasama nito, at walang sinisingil na lampas sa ipinakitang halaga.

marketing:v12.terms.fees.tuition.en: Hangyul does not collect university tuition. Tuition is paid directly to the university, in the member’s own name.
marketing:v12.terms.fees.tuition.cur: Hindi naniningil ang Hangyul ng matrikula sa unibersidad. Direktang binabayaran ang matrikula sa unibersidad, sa sariling pangalan ng miyembro.

marketing:v12.terms.intro.en: Hangyul Univ helps people preparing to study in Korea look up university information, get their documents and application steps ready, and use services such as consultations, essay editing and application management.
marketing:v12.terms.intro.cur: Tinutulungan ng Hangyul Univ ang mga naghahandang mag-aral sa Korea na tingnan ang impormasyon ng unibersidad, ihanda ang mga dokumento at hakbang sa aplikasyon, at gumamit ng mga serbisyo gaya ng konsultasyon, pag-edit ng essay at pag-manage ng aplikasyon.

marketing:v12.terms.ip.p.en: Rights in content Hangyul has produced for the service belong to Hangyul or to the rightful rights holder. Rights in university names, marks and images and in other third-party material belong to their respective holders, and their appearance in the service does not by itself indicate any relationship between Hangyul and that institution.
marketing:v12.terms.ip.p.cur: Ang mga karapatan sa nilalamang ginawa ng Hangyul para sa serbisyo ay pag-aari ng Hangyul o ng tamang may-hawak ng karapatan. Ang mga karapatan sa pangalan, marka at larawan ng unibersidad at sa iba pang materyal ng third party ay pag-aari ng kani-kanilang may-hawak, at ang paglabas nila sa serbisyo ay hindi nangangahulugang may ugnayan ang Hangyul at ang institusyong iyon.

marketing:v12.terms.liability.p.en: Hangyul is liable under applicable law for loss caused to a member by its intent or negligence in providing the service. Rights given to members by consumer-protection law are not limited by these terms. If a dispute arises, Hangyul and the member will first try to resolve it by discussion, and the member may apply for mediation to a dispute-resolution body such as the Korea Consumer Agency.
marketing:v12.terms.liability.p.cur: Mananagot ang Hangyul ayon sa naaangkop na batas para sa pinsalang naidulot sa miyembro dahil sa sinadya o kapabayaan nito sa pagbibigay ng serbisyo. Hindi nililimitahan ng mga tuntuning ito ang mga karapatang ibinibigay sa miyembro ng batas sa proteksyon ng consumer. Kapag may hindi pagkakaunawaan, susubukan muna ng Hangyul at ng miyembro na lutasin ito sa pag-uusap, at maaaring mag-apply ang miyembro ng mediation sa isang dispute-resolution body gaya ng Korea Consumer Agency.

marketing:v12.terms.privacy.p.en: What personal information Hangyul processes, why, for how long, who it is disclosed to and what rights you have are set out in the <privacy>privacy policy</privacy>.
marketing:v12.terms.privacy.p.cur: Nakasaad sa <privacy>patakaran sa privacy</privacy> kung anong personal na impormasyon ang pinoproseso ng Hangyul, bakit, gaano katagal, kanino ito ibinabahagi at kung ano ang iyong mga karapatan.

marketing:v12.terms.purpose.p.en: These terms set out the basic matters between Hangyul and members in connection with the use of the Hangyul Univ service.
marketing:v12.terms.purpose.p.cur: Itinatakda ng mga tuntuning ito ang mga pangunahing bagay sa pagitan ng Hangyul at ng mga miyembro kaugnay ng paggamit ng serbisyo ng Hangyul Univ.

marketing:v12.terms.refunds.commenced.en: Once the service has started, withdrawal may be restricted. You may still withdraw for the parts of the plan that have not yet started. The service is deemed to have started when the first consultation takes place. (Art. 17(2)5)
marketing:v12.terms.refunds.commenced.cur: Kapag nagsimula na ang serbisyo, maaaring limitahan ang pag-urong. Maaari ka pa ring umurong para sa mga bahagi ng plan na hindi pa nagsisimula. Itinuturing na nagsimula ang serbisyo kapag naganap ang unang konsultasyon. (Art. 17(2)5)

marketing:v12.terms.refunds.commercial.en: Hangyul’s refund schedule after the 7-day period (how delivered consultations and reviews are deducted) is set in a separate refund policy; until it is published, only the statutory rules above apply.

marketing:v20.city.Busan.body.en:
Busan is Korea's second-largest city and does not feel like a smaller Seoul. The universities sit between beaches and mountains, the subway reaches most of them, and rent runs well below the capital.
It has the country's largest port, a long-standing film festival, and a summer that the rest of Korea travels to. Winters are the mildest on the mainland.
marketing:v20.city.Busan.body.cur:
Ang Busan ang ikalawang pinakamalaking lungsod ng Korea, at hindi ito parang maliit na Seoul. Nasa pagitan ng dagat at bundok ang mga unibersidad, naaabot ng subway ang karamihan sa mga ito, at mas mura nang malaki ang upa kaysa sa kabisera.
Narito ang pinakamalaking pantalan ng bansa, isang matagal nang film festival, at tag-init na dinarayo ng buong Korea. Dito rin ang pinakabanayad na taglamig sa mainland.

marketing:v20.city.Busan.line.en: A port city of three and a half million, built along the sea and into the hills.
marketing:v20.city.Busan.line.cur: Isang lungsod-pantalan na may tatlo't kalahating milyong tao, nakalatag sa tabi ng dagat at paakyat sa mga burol.

marketing:v20.city.Chungbuk.body.en:
North Chungcheong is the only Korean province with no coastline. Cheongju is its center and its main university city, close enough to both Sejong and Daejeon to share their job market.
The province is known for Danyang's limestone scenery and for a quieter, cheaper student life than the metropolitan cities offer.

marketing:v20.city.Chungbuk.line.en: Landlocked, central, and built around Cheongju.

marketing:v20.city.Chungnam.body.en:
South Chungcheong runs from the west coast inland, and its university towns, Cheonan and Asan, are on the Seoul metro's line 1 as well as the KTX. That combination of capital-region access and provincial rent is why several large universities built campuses here.
Gongju and Buyeo, the old Baekje capitals, are in the same province and worth the afternoon.
marketing:v20.city.Chungnam.body.cur:
Umaabot ang South Chungcheong mula sa west coast papasok sa lupain, at ang mga university town nito, ang Cheonan at Asan, ay nasa Line 1 ng Seoul metro at sa KTX din. Ang kombinasyong ito ng lapit sa capital region at renta na pang-probinsya ang dahilan kung bakit maraming malalaking unibersidad ang nagtayo ng campus dito.
Nasa parehong probinsya ang Gongju at Buyeo, ang mga lumang kabisera ng Baekje, at sulit ang isang hapon doon.

marketing:v20.city.Chungnam.line.en: Between Seoul and the south. Cheonan and Asan are a commuter-train ride from the capital.
marketing:v20.city.Chungnam.line.cur: Sa pagitan ng Seoul at ng timog. Isang commuter-train ride lang ang Cheonan at Asan mula sa kabisera.

marketing:v20.city.Daegu.body.en:
Daegu sits in a bowl in the south-east and is the hottest city in Korea in August and one of the coldest in January. It has a dense, walkable center, a long textile history that became a fashion and medical-device industry, and a cost of living noticeably below Seoul or Busan.
The KTX puts Seoul within an hour and three quarters and Busan within fifty minutes.

marketing:v20.city.Daegu.line.en: An inland city in a basin of mountains, known for textiles, medicine and heat.

marketing:v20.city.Daejeon.body.en:
Daejeon was built up around Daedeok Innopolis, a cluster of government research institutes and corporate R&D centers, and the universities here are shaped by it. If you are coming for engineering or the natural sciences, this is where the laboratories are.
It is almost exactly in the middle of the country: an hour from Seoul by KTX and an hour from Busan.

marketing:v20.city.Daejeon.line.en: Korea's science city: research institutes, engineering campuses and a lot of laboratories.
marketing:v20.city.Daejeon.line.cur: Ang science city ng Korea: mga research institute, engineering campus at napakaraming laboratoryo.

marketing:v20.city.Gangwon.body.en:
Gangwon holds the Taebaek range, the 2018 Winter Olympics venues and the beaches of the east coast. Chuncheon, Gangneung and Wonju are the university towns; none of them is large, and all of them are cheaper and quieter than anywhere in the capital region.
Winters here are real winters. The KTX reaches Gangneung from Seoul in about two hours.

marketing:v20.city.Gangwon.line.en: Mountains and the east coast: the least dense and most scenic province.
marketing:v20.city.Gangwon.line.cur: Kabundukan at ang east coast: ang probinsyang pinakakaunti ang tao at pinakamaganda ang tanawin.

marketing:v20.city.Gwangju.body.en:
Gwangju is the largest city in the Jeolla provinces and carries their reputation for food and for the 1980 democratic uprising, which is still the thing the city is best known for in Korea.
It is one of the cheaper metropolitan cities to live in, has a well-regarded arts scene, and is about two hours from Seoul on the KTX.

marketing:v20.city.Gwangju.line.en: The cultural and political center of the south-west, and an affordable place to study.

marketing:v20.city.Gyeongbuk.body.en:
North Gyeongsang holds Gyeongju, the Silla capital for a millennium and effectively an open-air museum, and Pohang, a steel city that also hosts one of Korea's strongest science and engineering universities. Andong, further inland, is the center of Korean Confucian tradition.
It is a large, varied province, and all of it is cheaper than the capital region.

marketing:v20.city.Gyeongbuk.line.en: Gyeongju's thousand years of history and Pohang's steel, in the same province.

marketing:v20.city.Gyeonggi.body.en:
Gyeonggi wraps around Seoul and holds more universities than any other region except the capital itself. Suwon, Yongin, Seongnam and Bucheon are all 40–70 minutes from central Seoul on the metro or a direct bus, and rent is routinely a third less.
Campuses here tend to be larger and more self-contained than Seoul's, so more students live in university dormitories instead of off-campus studios.
marketing:v20.city.Gyeonggi.body.cur:
Nakapalibot ang Gyeonggi sa Seoul at mas marami itong unibersidad kaysa sa alinmang rehiyon maliban sa kabisera mismo. Ang Suwon, Yongin, Seongnam at Bucheon ay 40–70 minuto lang mula sa gitna ng Seoul sakay ng metro o direktang bus, at karaniwang mas mura nang mga one-third ang upa.
Kadalasang mas malalaki at mas kumpleto sa sarili ang mga campus dito kaysa sa Seoul, kaya mas maraming estudyante ang nakatira sa dormitoryo ng unibersidad sa halip na sa mga studio sa labas ng campus.

marketing:v20.city.Gyeonggi.line.en: The province around Seoul: cheaper, roomier, and still on the same subway map.
marketing:v20.city.Gyeonggi.line.cur: Ang probinsyang nakapalibot sa Seoul: mas mura, mas maluwag, at nasa parehong subway map pa rin.

marketing:v20.city.Gyeongnam.body.en:
South Gyeongsang wraps around Busan and shares its economy: machinery and shipbuilding in Changwon and Geoje, aerospace in Sacheon, and a coastline of fishing ports and islands further west.
Jinju and Changwon are the main university cities. Busan is never more than an hour away.
marketing:v20.city.Gyeongnam.body.cur:
Pinalilibutan ng South Gyeongsang ang Busan at kahati nito sa ekonomiya: makinarya at paggawa ng barko sa Changwon at Geoje, aerospace sa Sacheon, at baybaying may mga pantalan ng pangisda at isla sa kanluran.
Ang Jinju at Changwon ang pangunahing lungsod ng unibersidad. Hindi lalampas sa isang oras ang layo ng Busan.

marketing:v20.city.Gyeongnam.line.en: The industrial south coast: Changwon's factories and Tongyeong's harbors.
marketing:v20.city.Gyeongnam.line.cur: Ang industriyal na south coast: mga pabrika ng Changwon at mga daungan ng Tongyeong.

marketing:v20.city.Incheon.body.en:
Incheon is where you will land. It is also a university city in its own right: Songdo International Business District was built from reclaimed land in the last twenty years and now holds several campuses, including the Korean branches of foreign universities.
The airport railway puts central Seoul within an hour, and Incheon's old quarter (Chinatown, the port, Wolmido) feels like a different city from the new district.
marketing:v20.city.Incheon.body.cur:
Sa Incheon ka lalapag. Isa rin itong university city: ang Songdo International Business District ay itinayo sa reclaimed land nitong nakaraang dalawampung taon at may ilang campus na ngayon, kasama ang mga Korean branch ng mga dayuhang unibersidad.
Dadalhin ka ng airport railway sa gitna ng Seoul sa loob ng isang oras, at ang lumang bahagi ng Incheon (Chinatown, ang pantalan, Wolmido) ay parang ibang lungsod kumpara sa bagong distrito.

marketing:v20.city.Incheon.line.en: Korea's gateway city: the airport is in it, and so is Songdo.

marketing:v20.city.Jeju.body.en:
Jeju is 85 kilometers from the mainland, built around the Hallasan volcano, and warm enough that the vegetation looks subtropical. It is a holiday destination for the rest of the country, which shapes its economy and its rents.
There are few universities here and they are small. Flights to Seoul run every few minutes and take an hour.

marketing:v20.city.Jeju.line.en: A volcanic island off the south coast, and a different climate from the rest of Korea.

marketing:v20.city.Jeonbuk.body.en:
North Jeolla is agricultural, flat in the west and mountainous in the east, and Jeonju is its center: a city of about 650,000 with the largest surviving hanok quarter in the country and a food reputation no other Korean city disputes.
Living costs are among the lowest of any university city, and Seoul is a little under two hours by KTX.

marketing:v20.city.Jeonbuk.line.en: Jeonju, and the region known as the home of Korean food.

marketing:v20.city.Jeonnam.body.en:
South Jeolla has more islands than the rest of Korea combined, the Suncheon Bay wetlands, and Yeosu's harbor. It is the least urban of the mainland provinces and the universities here are correspondingly small and close-knit.
If you want a quiet place with a coastline and very low living costs, this is it.

marketing:v20.city.Jeonnam.line.en: The south-west coast, its islands, and the slowest pace in the country.

marketing:v20.city.Sejong.body.en:
Sejong is Korea's newest city and the most deliberately planned: most of the central ministries moved here from Seoul, and the street layout, the parks and the public buildings all date from the last fifteen years.
It is small, quiet and extremely new, twenty minutes from Daejeon and an hour and a half from Seoul.

marketing:v20.city.Sejong.line.en: A city built from nothing since 2012 to hold the government ministries.

marketing:v20.city.Seoul.body.en:
Seoul puts about a quarter of the country's population into one metropolitan area, and most of its best-known universities into a handful of neighborhoods: Sinchon, Anam, Gwanak and Heukseok. The subway runs until roughly midnight and a student fare across the city is about 1,500 won, so where you live and where you study do not have to be the same district.
It is the most expensive place in Korea to rent and the easiest to find part-time work, English-language services, and other people from your own country.
marketing:v20.city.Seoul.body.cur:
Halos sangkapat ng populasyon ng bansa ang nasa iisang metropolitan area ng Seoul, at karamihan ng pinakakilalang unibersidad nito ay nasa ilang neighborhood lang: Sinchon, Anam, Gwanak at Heukseok. Tumatakbo ang subway hanggang mga hatinggabi at mga 1,500 won ang student fare kahit saan sa lungsod, kaya hindi kailangang nasa iisang distrito ang tinitirhan at pinag-aaralan mo.
Ito ang pinakamahal na lugar sa Korea para umupa, at ang pinakamadaling lugar para makahanap ng part-time na trabaho, mga serbisyo sa English, at ibang tao mula sa sarili mong bansa.

marketing:v20.city.Seoul.line.en: Half of Korea's research universities are within an hour of each other here.
marketing:v20.city.Seoul.line.cur: Kalahati ng mga research university ng Korea ay isang oras lang ang layo sa isa't isa rito.

marketing:v20.city.Ulsan.body.en:
Ulsan has the highest average income of any Korean city, and the reason is easy to see: the world's largest shipyard, a car plant that is a district on its own, and a petrochemical complex along the coast. Engineering graduates are hired here.
It is a small city by Korean standards, half an hour from Busan, with whale-watching, a long beach and the Taehwa river running through the center.
marketing:v20.city.Ulsan.body.cur:
Ang Ulsan ang may pinakamataas na average na kita sa mga lungsod sa Korea, at madaling makita kung bakit: ang pinakamalaking shipyard sa mundo, isang Hyundai car plant na kasinlaki ng isang buong distrito, at petrochemical complex sa baybayin. Dito nakakakuha ng trabaho ang mga engineering graduate.
Maliit na lungsod ito ayon sa pamantayan ng Korea, kalahating oras mula Busan, may whale-watching, mahabang beach at ang Taehwa river na dumadaloy sa gitna.

marketing:v20.city.Ulsan.line.en: Korea's industrial capital: shipbuilding, cars and petrochemicals.
